question: Does PR9 S02 reduce-scatter apply to the actual gsplat_renderer_3d_normals logical7/physical8 path?
feature_layout: RGB + minor-axis Gaussian normal xyz =6 raster colors; RGB+ED appends depth =7 logical; wrapper pads to COLOR_DIM=8; scatter components=16
decision: Support a focused COLOR_DIM<=8 S02 extension PR; do not claim forward speedup or 4K/full-training speedup.
limitations: One native timing job per selected view with 30 CUDA-event repeats; backward improvement is consistent across three views but needs broader follow-up.
4K comparison was not accepted because the baseline repeat reference failed the strict raw full-parameter noise gate.
No training convergence or optimizer-step claim.
